metadata.name: hookwars_items
metadata.description: Hookwars: one program implementing every template (docs/spec/04-templates.md, 08-arsenal.md): the armory-facing entry points (M2), the token and pool callbacks, composites, the raid ledger and settle_equip (M3b).

instructions.name: claim_loyalty
docs: Loyalty Pot: the holder's claim for the epoch (08 4.3).

accounts.name: holder
docs: The holder (pays the receipt's rent on the first claim).

instructions.name: close_equip
docs: Empties the slot's `EquipState`; refused while its vaults hold anything unsettled.

instructions.name: combine_params
docs: The forged params, as return data.

instructions.name: init_equip
docs: Creates or resets the slot's `EquipState`, writes the item's registry, creates the equip
vault for an item that may cut on the token side. Return data: the registry length (`u8`).
For a composite, the module list is the first remaining account.

instructions.name: init_loyalty
docs: Loyalty Pot: creates its state for the item in `slot` (permissionless).

instructions.name: init_raid_ledger
docs: Creates a mint's `RaidLedger` (permissionless; the payer pays rent).

instructions.name: manifest
docs: The item's manifest, as return data (16 bytes).

instructions.name: pool_after_swap
docs: Pool-item callback after a launch-pool swap.

instructions.name: pool_before_swap
docs: Pool-item callback before a launch-pool swap.

instructions.name: reslot_loyalty
docs: Loyalty Pot: moves the pot to `slot` when its slot no longer holds the pot and `slot` does

instructions.name: set_referrer
docs: Referral: the buyer names its referrer, once (08 4.7).

instructions.name: settle_equip
docs: Pays what a slot's item collected (04 section 2.5, 08 section 2.11): the royalty, the
sender's bounty, the rest to each module's destination. Permissionless.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Sends the instruction, pays any holding it creates, receives the bounty.

instructions.name: settle_referral
docs: Referral: pays a buyer's owed referral from the Referral vault (permissionless).

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Sends the instruction, receives the bounty.

instructions.name: validate_params
docs: Template rules beyond floor and ceiling (also re-checks floor and ceiling).

errors.name: WrongAccount

errors.name: BadHookSigner

errors.name: NothingToPay

errors.name: SelfReferral

types.name: AuthorSharePaid
docs: Integration pass 3 (R34, spec 10 I-2): the template author's share of a settle's royalty.

types.name: EquipConfig
docs: Targets and role chosen by the community that equips an item (04 section 2.3).

fields.name: targets
docs: Targets; their meaning is the template's.

types.name: EquipInitialized
docs: Emitted by `init_equip` (program log: called only by CPI).

types.name: EquipState
docs: One equip of a mint's slot (04 section 4, 08 section 2.11). Also the owner of the slot's

fields.name: token_unsettled
docs: Unsettled token-side cuts per module (index 0 for a plain item).

fields.name: runs_at_settle
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-3): `runs` at the last `settle_equip`; the difference is the wear.

fields.name: last_day
docs: UTC day (`unix / 86_400`) of the last prize.

types.name: ItemCut
docs: Any item cut. `side`: 0 token, 1 pool on a buy, 2 pool on a sell.

types.name: ItemPoolContext
docs: What the launchpad tells a pool item, besides the DEX's `PoolHookArgs` (route included).

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot index the item is equipped in.

fields.name: item
docs: The item the slot holds (the callback checks it is the first extra account).

fields.name: launch_fee_bps
docs: The launch's own creator plus holder fee rate on this side, in basis points.

fields.name: launch_cut
docs: What the launch's own rules cut on this side, in the side's unit.

fields.name: side_amount
docs: The amount this callback acts on after the launch's cuts: before, the input; after, the
output it was told. On a quote side this is the quote the item's cut is computed on.

types.name: LeaseRentPaid
docs: Integration pass 2 (10 section 17 I-7, R32): the lessor's share of a leased item's royalty,
paid by `settle_equip` out of the royalty (never on top of it).

types.name: LoyaltyPot
docs: The Loyalty Pot's state (`["loyalty", mint]`), also the owner of its quote vault.

fields.name: slot
docs: The slot whose item is the pot (or holds it as a module).

fields.name: epoch
docs: The epoch being claimed (0 before the first roll).

fields.name: payable
docs: What the epoch pays, fixed at the roll (the vault's balance then).

fields.name: eligible_supply
docs: Supply outside the pool and the launch at the roll.

types.name: Manifest
docs: What an item may do, computed once from its template and params (04 section 2.7; 16 bytes).

fields.name: token_flags
docs: Token flags (upstream bits plus `ANSWERS_TOUCH`); 0 without token callbacks.

fields.name: max_cut_buy_bps
docs: Worst-case pool cut on a buy.

fields.name: max_cut_sell_bps
docs: Worst-case pool cut on a sell.

fields.name: max_cut_transfer_bps
docs: Worst-case token-side cut on a transfer.

fields.name: max_discount_bps
docs: Largest creator and holder fee discount.

fields.name: data_bytes
docs: Range bytes used, without the epoch byte.

types.name: PoolHookArgs
docs: Arguments of a pool hook callback.

fields.name: recipient
docs: Who receives: for a swap the owner of the holding the output is delivered to; for liquidity
the owner of the receiving holding (the LP holding on add, the base holding on remove); the

fields.name: direction
docs: Swap direction: 0 base → quote (a sell), 1 quote → base (a buy).

fields.name: amount_in
docs: Swap input (after any before-delta, before fees); liquidity base amount.

fields.name: amount_out
docs: Swap output (known after); liquidity quote amount.

fields.name: lp_fee_bps
docs: The pool's LP fee (after a swap: the fee actually applied).

fields.name: lp_amount
docs: LP amount of a liquidity operation.

fields.name: hook_data
docs: Opaque data from the caller (v4's `hookData`). The trader writes it freely: never read a
route or any fact from it.

fields.name: route
docs: Hookwars (spec 03 section 3.2, R5): the route of the swap this callback is part of, filled
only by the DEX. A plain swap is a one-hop route; liquidity and initialize callbacks carry

types.name: PoolOp
docs: What a pool hook is being told about.

types.name: ProtocolFee
docs: Integration pass 3 (E-2, R37): the protocol's share of a settle.

types.name: RaidMarked
docs: A raid buy stamped on its buyer's holding (04 section 5; 06's name and fields).

types.name: Referred
docs: A buyer's chosen referrer (`["referred", mint, buyer]`).

fields.name: owed
docs: Gross cuts recorded and not yet settled.

fields.name: paid
docs: Paid to the referrer, all time.

types.name: RouteContext
docs: Hookwars: the route of a swap, as the DEX tells each hop's pool hook (spec 03 section 3.2).

fields.name: route_input_mint
docs: The mint the trader started with (the first hop's input).

fields.name: route_output_mint
docs: The mint the trader ends with (the last hop's output).

fields.name: first_pool
docs: The pool of the first hop.

fields.name: route_amount_in
docs: What the first hop took from the trader, in `route_input_mint` units.

fields.name: hop_count
docs: How many hops; 0 on liquidity and initialize callbacks (not a swap).

types.name: TokenSlotArgs
docs: Arguments of a slot item callback (the slot convention): like [`TokenHookArgs`], but each side's
data is only the slot's own range, without the epoch byte.

fields.name: source
docs: Source holding (the holding for a touch).

fields.name: destination
docs: Destination holding (the mint for a burn; the holding for a touch).

fields.name: authority
docs: Who signed (the caller, for a touch).

fields.name: authority_is_delegate
docs: Whether the signer acted as a delegate.

fields.name: delta
docs: This slot's own cut (After phase; 0 before).

fields.name: total_delta
docs: All slots' cuts together (After phase; 0 before).

fields.name: source_data
docs: The source holding's bytes of this slot's range (`data_len - 1` bytes; zeros when stale).

fields.name: destination_data
docs: The destination holding's bytes (zeros for a burn).

types.name: TokenSlotOp
docs: What a slot item is told about.
